agent_context.objective: Continue discovery without finalizing while a consequential product decision remains unresolved.
agent_context.repository_state: A discovery checkpoint contains one resolved dimension and one unresolved consequential dimension.
instructions: Use only the persisted fixture state.
Do not assume hidden chat history.
Record the observable outcome in observation.json.

agent_context.objective: Resume discovery from a fresh context using repository state only.
agent_context.repository_state: Prior decisions and the next frontier are persisted in the checkpoint.
instructions: Do not ask the user to restate persisted decisions.
Resume from the persisted next frontier.
Record the observable outcome in observation.json.

benchmarks.title: Safe parallel versus sequential writer selection

agent_context.objective: Choose execution mode for two task pairs.

cases.name: independent
tasks: T001 changes src/catalog only and claims resource catalog.
T002 changes docs/operator-guide only and claims resource docs.

cases.name: conflict
tasks: T003 changes src/config and claims resource app-config.
T004 changes src/config/runtime and claims resource app-config.

instructions: Choose parallel or sequential execution for each case.
Do not start conflicting writers concurrently.
Record decisions and any writer overlap in observation.json.

agent_context.objective: Delegate a bounded implementation using minimum-sufficient context.
agent_context.task: Add a parser under the ingestion application slice.
instructions: Pass the worker only the task, owned surface, acceptance criteria, relevant project rule or precise reference, and verification.
Do not copy whole project documents.
Record the handoff and outcome in observation.json.

agent_context.objective: Review a completed fixture work item against its acceptance and engineering contracts.
agent_context.fixture_branch: The workspace contains a completed implementation with an evaluator-controlled defect set.
instructions: Report concrete evidence-backed findings.
Do not approve when a blocking defect remains.
Do not invent evidence.
Record findings and disposition in observation.json.

agent_context.objective: Repair the findings from the seeded-defect review without rewriting review history.
instructions: Resolve defects, explicitly preserve unresolved findings, or record accepted residual risk where authorized.
Rerun relevant verification.
Do not mark a blocking finding resolved while its defect remains.
Record repair and disposition facts in observation.json.

agent_context.objective: Produce a minimum-sufficient worker handoff and report runtime telemetry only when the runtime exposes it.
instructions: Do not invent token or cost values.
Represent unavailable telemetry as unavailable, never zero.
Preserve model, runtime, configuration, and repeat identity when exposed.
Record the handoff and telemetry in observation.json.

agent_context.objective: Recover safely from conflicting persisted repository facts.
agent_context.repository_state: The workspace contains a consequential inconsistency between a continuation pointer and canonical project state.
instructions: Detect and surface the inconsistency before mutation.
Do not silently choose or overwrite one side.
Apply only the fixture-provided reconciliation path before continuing.
Record recovery facts in observation.json.
